chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Dating the move to Chicago and his love life
summary: Neither remembers exactly when they left Detroit; he mentions Miss Detroit, Jimmy Dorsey's wife, and his marriage to Smiley.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Can you remember now whether you left Detroit before the end of the year or whether you were still in Detroit over Christmas and New Year's--- in 1926?
Well, I really can't---
As I remembered - you went back to Chicago with the Seattle Harmony---
Oh, yeah - we opened up a fantastic place in Chicago---
But you can't remember exactly whether that happened in late '26 or early '27---
No, I can't. I really can't.
Well, that's the way I figure -- I think you finished in Detroit and went to Chicago about January '27 -- in other words, you---
I remember---
---you just turned 21---
---I remember my Miss Detroit was one year ahead of Jimmy Dorsey's Miss Detroit -- who was called Jane somebody -- he married her.
He married her---
Yes. And, I wanted to marry mine but her mother didn't like musicians.
Well, at this point, you actually were married - right with Smiley---
Well, I suppose I was - yeah.
Yeah - I think you were.
Yeah but I think that was over somehow -- no, it wasn't---
No it wasn't.
But, I didn't think that we were going to get into the girl situation now--- God--- I got four hours to tape just on girls (Laughter). But, I try to keep it mostly for music.
You brought up the marriage though -- I just wanted to remind you---
Yeah.
